SELECTED_INDEX: 1
CONFIDENCE: 0.78
EXPLANATION: Strong nitro-aromatic signature: νs(NO2) at 1340 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-022), νas(NO2) near 1576 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-022), NO2 out-of-plane δ around 738 cm⁻¹ (cf. nitro δ ≈752; GFQ-022) and in-plane bend near 843 cm⁻¹. The prominent 1467 cm⁻¹ band fits CH3 scissoring from the methyl substituent, and the weak 2947 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with aliphatic C–H stretch alongside aromatic C–H stretches around 3115–3166 cm⁻¹. These features collectively point to a nitro-substituted aromatic with an N–H heteroaromatic ring, matching candidate 1.
